description: Read suggestions, published revisions, or the discussion on one public document. Use this to see proposed edits (state open, merged or rejected, with mergeContent and any mergeError) or comments. Do not use it to read the document body. The owner reviews an open suggestion with heystack_review_suggestion.

id.description: Document id, a UUID or a legacy number. A /doc/ URL in this field is accepted. Kept for existing clients.

slug.description: Document slug from the URL. If several documents share it, the call returns their URLs.

surface.description: activity returns suggestions and published revisions. discussion returns comments and tasks.

url.description: Public document URL, such as https://heystacks.com/doc/{id}/{slug} or that path plus .md.

name: heystack_read_activity
title: Read document activity
